claim_one_line: WHAT HOLDS TAU (P-251; computed, no data): W62's PH3 is B1686's cusp algebra -- a content holds tau off the cusp only if its total cusp coefficient is negative (31/1024 = (31/512)/2), and every content on record is positive (5.45 to 66.57 zeta(6)), so none holds tau; adding trivial-sector Weyl fermions holds tau at i or near omega, where there is no hierarchy; scalars twisted along the shrinking cycle leave no minimum on the CP lines; a minimum in the hierarchy band needs net bosons in the matter's representation and a nearly cancelled cusp coefficient (matter + Higgs + 89-95 such scalars; with the gauge fields 595-672, with the graviton 689-780), each scalar moving tau* by 0.01-0.2 -- a fine-tuned integer content that nothing on record selects. 0 of 19.
